notes.title: Now Available on Steam - Lost Chronicles of Zerzura, 10% off!
notes.content:
Lost Chronicles of Zerzura is Now Available on Steam and is 10% off!*

When one brother is taken away by the Inquisition, the other must search for answers that will set his imprisoned sibling free. You’ll be quickly immersed in an extraordinary expedition, as you explore the ravishingly beautiful and detailed locations and solve a unique combination of puzzles, mini-games, and other challenges within the breathtaking storyline. Forge strong alliances with those you meet along the way to evade further attacks by the brutal inquisition. Trek across remarkable landscapes to the legendary desert city of ZERZURA, where an ancient terror guards over powerful secrets - and poses the greatest challenge of all!

*Offer ends July 17 at 10AM Pacific Time
